method: Itemized charitable contributions (A19700) divided by adjusted gross income (A00100), per county, tax year 2022; also the share of returns claiming the deduction (N19700/N1). Counties under 500 returns are not shown.
measurement_warning: Only 9.6% of returns itemized in 2022 and 7.6% claimed a charitable deduction. Gifts by the other ~90% of filers are invisible here. This layer shows where giving is recorded on tax returns — tracking income, home values and state tax law — not how generous a place is. The 'Kindness' slot stays PENDING for that.
